text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Speed is indispensable in the Satsuki Sho.
Yet, one also needs the grit to overcome
that steep uphill slope.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Above all else—this year's roster is truly
packed with talent, as expected.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Rulership...
Hailing from that academy with its
many ties to the Rose Clan,
she withdrew to
prepare for the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
And yet—
Eishin Flash-senpai and Victoire Pisa are
both in the lineup.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rulership was an intellectual Umamusume who
loved board games,
a formidable competitor hailing from the
same academy as Student Council Vice President
Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And then there is Eishin Flash,
an Umamusume hailing from Germany.
Punctual and earnest to a fault,
she reportedly lives her daily life
scheduled down to the minute.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Victoire Pisa, like the others,
was in Rose Kingdom's class,
currently challenging the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Victoire Pisa in particular was riding a
winning streak,
seen alongside Asahi Hai FS victor Rose
Kingdom
as one of the generation's top two.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Beyond her continuous upward growth,
one reason for her popularity was—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Through victory,
I wish to connect the circle and weave our
hearts together.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
And so—
I want to create an unyielding circle of
hope.
I will never, ever leave anyone all alone.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Lay in a pure, upright character,
at times even described as an 'angel'.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
She's an opponent I already clashed with in
my debut race.
Since I remember her running style to some
degree,
predicting her moves will be easier than
with the others.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Nevertheless,
that does not change the fact that she is
a formidable opponent.
We must approach this with utmost
vigilance.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Haah... whew!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(My time has improved considerably.
At this rate—perhaps...)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaah—!!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh, hah, hah!
~~~gh, ...ngh!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Not yet... It's not over yet...
This is where it starts...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaah—!!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...Is that—Pisa...?!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(Had her running ever possessed such sheer
sharpness?
—To have grown so remarkably in but a single
year?)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Nice to meet you, I'm Victoire Pisa.
I look forward to working with everyone!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
As for my 'strength'... well—
despite appearances,
I'm actually quite physically sturdy.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Hence, I am relatively capable
of handling high-intensity training.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...So you put that physique to good use.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(As things stand,
victory will remain out of reach.
We, too,
must make appropriate preparations—)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Would it be possible to conduct
higher-intensity training at the Ibaramine
Training Center?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...
I saw Pisa on the track last night.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rose Kingdom spoke quietly of Victoire Pisa's
remarkable growth,
and the sense of urgency it had awakened
within her.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
She now stands as a towering wall before
the Satsuki Sho.
Unless we surpass Pisa――the crown cannot be
ours.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
To vanquish the formidable foes to come,
I have no choice but to push this body to
its absolute limits.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Therefore,
I ask of you.
Review the intensity once more.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: Now then—the moment is finally here!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
The Satsuki Sho!
Said to be won by the fastest of all
Umamusume,
it marks the opening battle of the Classic
Triple Crown!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
It's gotta be Victoire Pisa! I mean,
she's been on absolute fire lately.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Nah, by that logic,
Rose is in the running too!
She achieved the long-cherished dream,
so my hopes are high.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Rose-san.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
In a race with you, I know we can...
I know we can unite the entire crowd into
one great circle.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Ever since we fought in our debut race and
I felt your true strength firsthand, Rose-san,
I've thought so all along.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
If only I could catch up,
stand beside them,
and clash with every fiber of my being.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely why I have made
every possible preparation for this day.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Let us connect the hearts of all and forge
a circle together.
And that victory—I shall bring it to pass.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—...To receive such lavish praise from an
Umamusume of your caliber.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Our purpose is the same, then. I, too,
wish to ignite enough passion in this race
to connect our hearts.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—Yet that was solely to make the name of
the Rose Kingdom known throughout the
land,
and secure the clan's standing beyond
reproach.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
The one who shall defeat you and claim the
crown is me.
